snippet.title: The Empathy Algorithm (Trailer)
snippet.description:
Wishlist now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4219480/The_Empathy_Algorithm/

"Sometimes the most dangerous question is the one you don't realize you're answering..."

You are Erin Cole, a university student volunteering for a paid experiment conducted by "Cognitech Solutions" - the world's leading name in advanced android technology.
But they didn't prepare you for this...

The task seemed simple: Talk to an android, ask questions, evaluate how human it appears. But when Ji-jeon Park enters the test chamber and insists she is a human, paid to test you, lines begin to blur.

What starts as casual small talk evolves into intense discussions about love, identity, death and traumas.
Until you realize: This experiment will claim a life...
-------------
FEATURES:
- Fully Voice-Acted
- Visual Short Story: A focused, narrative-driven experience designed to be completed in about one hour.
- Philosophical Sci-Fi: Themes of humanity, free will and mortality take the spotlight
- Minimalist Gameplay: No combat, no puzzles, no minigames. Just words, decisions and consequences.
- Four Endings
